news.title: Anthropic pours another $20 million into AI safety group
news.summary: Anthropic will pour another $20 million into Public First Action, the nonprofit organization advocating for safeguards on artificial intelligence. The contribution, announced by the company Wednesday, brings the Claude-maker’s total funds given to the group to $40 million.
